messages:
alex: Heads-up: we've got a change landing in the SDK batch inference endpoint that could be breaking for some partners. TL;DR: renaming `max_items` -> `item_limit` and switching server behavior to interpret 0 as "unbounded". Need partner coordination.
priya: ahhh ok. which SDKs/packages are shipping this week? marketplace SDKs? hardware partner libs?
alex: marketplace JS/py packages and the in-house Rust shim for hardware partners. Release branch scheduled for next Tue. No release notes yet.
marco: that's going to break our SI integrators using old clients. They pass 0 for default behavior currently. Are we changing semantics or just the name?
sarah: both. Name rename + behavior tweak: we want explicit unbounded semantics rather than relying on omission. Helps with server batching logic and perf glue.
partner-ops: partner list: AcmeEdge (hardware), CloudMarket listing, AtlasSI. AcmeEdge uses the Rust shim directly.
jane: can we add a compatibility header or accept both fields for a transitional window? That would avoid immediate breakage.
alex: implementation plan: middleware will accept `max_items` for a transition window and emit a warning. Propose 90d. After that we remove support. We still need partner comms and marketplace approval for the compatibility shim though.
priya: 90d feels more reasonable for SI+hardware. Also request an opt-in feature flag for Dedicated/Private so customers can toggle strict mode during their cert cycles.
marco: +1 on 90d. Hardware partners have slower cert cycles and need time for firmware/shim updates.
thomas: for Marketplace listing updates we need docs, migration guide, sample diffs, and a compatibility badge. Draft migration snippet: 

``
# old
{"batch": [...], "max_items": 0}

# new
{"batch": [...], "item_limit": 0}  # 0 = unbounded
```

alex: thanks. action items: 1) DevRel: migration guide + quick patch (jane) 2) Runtime: accept both keys + warning metric for 90d (sarah) 3) Eng-sre: feature flag for strict mode on Dedicated/Private (thomas) 4) Partner Ops: targeted outreach to AcmeEdge/AtlasSI/CloudMarket (partner-ops).
jane: I'll put together a short one-pager + code samples and open PRs in marketplace SDKs today. ETA EOD.
sarah: will put middleware in canary on staging and add warning metric -> #sdk-compat-alerts. ETA 2 days.
partner-ops: I'll schedule joint comms and request expedited marketplace approval for compatibility patch. Will ping partners and log their cert timelines.
priya: also add a note for release notes: explain reason (batching perf + determinism), timeline (90d), and example migration. Avoid technical jargon in partner-facing comms.
marco: good. one more: make sure telemetry marks which clients used `max_items` so we can follow up.
alex: agreed. I'll own telemetry query + weekly report to the partners list.
